sentences.text: the Ld. MM, Saket Courts, New Delhi;

III. Criminal Appeal No. 284/2023, against the order of in-t-e-rim maintenance,
which has remained reserved or . deferred despite conclusion of arguments.

b) Pass appropriate orders under Article 226/227 of the Constitution of India by calling for records in the above matters, and taking comprehensive cognizance of the proceedings, so as to prevent further miscarriage of justice;'
4. Issue notice.
The learned ASC accepts notice on behalf of the State, and the learned counsel for respondent no. 2 accepts notice.
5. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner prays that the learned Trial Court be directed to dispose of the aforementioned proceedings, in a time bound manner.
6. Having heard the learned counsel, the learned Trial Court is directed to dispose of the aforementioned proceedings expeditiously.
However, at this stage, this Court is not inclined to make an order time bound.
In case the proceedings are not concluded expeditiously, the learned counsel for the petitioner will be at liberty to approach this Court afresh.
7. With these directions, the petition stands disposed of.
8. A copy of this order be sent to the learned Trial Court for information and necessary compliance.
9. The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
DR. SWARANA KANTA SHARMA, J JULY 08, 2025/A
